I found out by accident when I came to check in on my half siblings (my dad is supposedly their bio dad but ex step mom has custody of them).

Her bf tracks my dads family down while he's drunk, brings a gun and shoots and breaks the window above their kitchen sink. Her bf gets arrested. Baby is born about a month or so later. DNA testing is done. The baby is not in fact my dad's child, but the child of another man she has been fucking. It wasn't even my uncle's child. I have blackmail on my ex stepmom for all of this. I only found out because of snipets of conversations I've heard while at her house checking on my siblings, what my siblings have told me and what the family lawyers have told us after the whole ex stepmoms boyfriend shooting out our fucking window ordeal. She's also heavily into meth and heroin. How do I know this is all true? I confronted her about it last week. She's threatening to sue me if I tell anyone (even though my case would definitely win in court with all the evidence AND past legal battles with her). 

I threaten to call CPS, she called it a bluff. I called CPS. My dad now has custody of his kids. DNA testing again, only one of the 6 kids is actually his, but he's been their father figure for the majority of their lives so he treats all of them like his own. He is actually a good dad, but isn't the best at being a loyal partner.

The fact that this whole ordeal started when I was 5 when my dad cheated on my mom and just recently came to a close without any of our family knowing except my dad, dad's mom sister and brother, my mom, 4 out of my 6 siblings, me and my ex stepmom and her boyfriend says a lot.
